lines: TIRUVIDAIMARUDHUR SRIVATSAN SIVASHANKAR, Key Managerial Personnel, sells 80,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹5.60 crore arrive on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares of up to ₹36.64 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) mean more value stays with them after listing.
Gain figure unknown: average cost of acquisition not confirmed from the documents.
